# walite v1.2.1

This cosmetic patch replaces Walite's application and notification artwork with
the approved transparent-corner assets. Messaging, notification eligibility,
click-to-chat, privacy defaults and storage behavior are unchanged from v1.2.0.

## Changes

- Updated the macOS helper artwork source while preserving the permanent bundle
  identifier `io.github.antoinebaudrimontbeep.walite.notifier`
- Updated the dedicated 48×48 Linux notification icon
- Native macOS packaging continues to generate and validate every `.icns`
  representation before ad hoc signing
- Raised the macOS helper bundle build number from 4 to 5 so systems can
  distinguish the cosmetic update

## Installation

Download the archive for your operating system and architecture, verify it with
`SHA256SUMS`, and follow the existing README upgrade/rollback instructions.
Upgrading does not require re-pairing and must not remove the linked session,
SQLite cache or preferences.

## Known limitations

- Walite must be running to receive notifications; it is not a daemon.
- Depending on WhatsApp synchronization timing, a message received while Walite
  was offline may still produce a notification after reconnect.
- Linux notification actions and expiration depend on the desktop daemon.
- The macOS helper remains ad hoc signed and is not notarized.
- Animated WebP preview depends on the viewer; expired media may remain unavailable.

walite is unofficial and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by
WhatsApp or Meta.

**Full changelog:** [v1.2.0...v1.2.1](https://github.com/antoinebaudrimont-beep/walite/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1)
